newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanwa Bank jumps on inclusion in key stock average.
newsitem.headline: Sanwa Bank jumps on inclusion in key stock average.

text.p: Shares of Sanwa Bank Ltd jumped in Wednesday morning trade on the news that the issue will be included in the key 225-share Nikkei average from September 24, traders said.
Meanwhile, Honshu Paper Co Ltd slipped, as its shares will be delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange when the company merges with New Oji Paper Co Ltd.
The share price of Sanwa Bank gained 90 yen to trade at 2,080 at 0111 GMT, on volume of 2.707 million shares.
The share price of Honshu Paper lost 28 yen to 668 by 0116 GMT, on volume of 1.09 million shares.
